name: Fixed 20-sentence chunks (no keyword filter)
description: Slide a 20-sentence window across the full doc with stride 20 (non-overlapping). Each window becomes its own LLM call — the model tags everything inside. Answers the notes doc's option B: 'Split doc into chunks (e.g., N sentence chunks, maybe try 20, 40) – ask it to tag everything inside.' No keyword filter — every sentence is seen at least once.
